meta.comment: Daily overdue-loan reminders. Flow: schedule -> sign request -> GET Convex /overdue-loans (HMAC, timestamped) -> one item per loan -> reminder (SAFE DEFAULT: logged mock; real email node present but DISABLED with placeholder credential) -> signed POST write-back to Convex /reminders/writeback with an idempotency key (loanId + date), so retries never double-record. After importing: set env CONVEX_SITE_URL (the .convex.site URL) and LENDLOOP_SHARED_SECRET to match the Convex deployment, and set the Error Workflow in Settings to 'LendLoop - Error Handler'.

nodes.name: Send Reminder Email (disabled)
nodes.notes: Disabled on purpose. Configure a real SMTP credential, then enable and disable the mock node instead.
